AI Short Video Factory - 短视频工厂

🚀 一键生成产品营销与泛内容短视频，AI批量自动剪辑，高颜值跨平台桌面端工具

[![贡献者][contributors-shield]][contributors-url] [![分支][forks-shield]][forks-url] [![星标][stars-shield]][stars-url] [![问题][issues-shield]][issues-url] [![最新版本][release-shield]][release-url] [![许可证][license-shield]][license-url]

报告Bug · 请求功能

## 📖 关于项目 短视频工厂是一个开源的桌面端应用，旨在通过AI技术简化短视频的制作流程。用户可以通过简单的提示词文本+视频分镜素材，快速且自动的剪辑出高质量的产品营销和泛内容短视频。该项目集成了AI驱动的文案生成、语音合成、视频剪辑、字幕特效等功能，旨在为用户提供开箱即用的短视频制作体验。 ### 核心功能 - 🤖 **AI驱动**：集成了最新的AI技术，提升视频制作效率和质量 - 📝 **文案生成**：基于提示词生成高质量的短视频文案 - 🎥 **自动剪辑**：支持多种视频格式，自动化批量处理视频剪辑任务 - 🎙️ **语音合成**：将生成的文案转换为自然流畅的语音 - 🎬 **字幕特效**：自动添加字幕和特效，提升视频质量 - 📦 **批量处理**：支持批量任务，按预设自动持续合成视频 - 🌐 **多语言支持**：支持中文、英文等多种语言，满足不同用户需求 - 📦 **开箱即用**：无需复杂配置，用户可以快速上手 - 📈 **持续更新**：定期发布新版本，修复bug并添加新功能 - 🔒 **安全可靠**：完全本地本地化运行，确保用户数据安全 - 🎨 **用户友好**：简洁直观的用户界面，易于操作 - 💻 **多平台支持**：支持Windows、macOS和Linux等多个操作系统

AI Short Video Factory

🚀 Create product marketing and general-interest short videos in one click with AI-powered batch editing in a polished, cross-platform desktop app

[![Contributors][contributors-shield]][contributors-url] [![Forks][forks-shield]][forks-url] [![Stars][stars-shield]][stars-url] [![Issues][issues-shield]][issues-url] [![Latest Release][release-shield]][release-url] [![License][license-shield]][license-url]

Report a Bug · Request a Feature

## 📖 About the Project AI Short Video Factory is an open-source desktop application designed to simplify short video production with AI. With a simple text prompt and video clips for each scene, users can quickly and automatically edit high-quality product marketing and general-interest short videos. The project brings together AI-powered script generation, speech synthesis, video editing, and subtitle effects to deliver an out-of-the-box video creation experience. ### Key Features - 🤖 **AI-Powered**: Integrates the latest AI technologies to improve video production efficiency and quality - 📝 **Script Generation**: Generates high-quality short video scripts from prompts - 🎥 **Automated Editing**: Supports multiple video formats and automates batch video editing tasks - 🎙️ **Speech Synthesis**: Converts generated scripts into natural-sounding speech - 🎬 **Subtitle Effects**: Automatically adds subtitles and effects to enhance videos - 📦 **Batch Processing**: Supports batch tasks that continuously render videos using presets - 🌐 **Multilingual Support**: Supports Chinese, English, and other languages to meet different user needs - 📦 **Ready to Use**: Get started quickly without complicated configuration - 📈 **Regular Updates**: New releases include bug fixes and new features - 🔒 **Secure and Reliable**: Runs locally to keep user data secure - 🎨 **User-Friendly**: A clean, intuitive interface that is easy to use - 💻 **Cross-Platform**: Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux
